items.html:
Emirati seamer Fahad Alhashmi has been in and out of UAE's national side since his first-class debut against Ireland in the Intercontinental Cup in 2005, with work commitments interrupting a part-time cricket career. After a gap of more than four years he returned to the national squad when UAE hosted Afghanistan in December 2014 on the back of consistent performances for his club side, Farooq CC.
Liam Brickhill
